title: Enable Cost Control Strategies for Business Central Telemetry

features.name: Telemetry Usage and Estimated Costs View
features.description: A feature in the configure menu that allows users to see an overview of their monthly telemetry payments for Application Insights.
caveats: Shows zero for new resources with no data yet
Requires data ingestion before costs appear

features.name: Daily Cap for Telemetry Ingestion
features.description: A configurable setting that allows users to define a maximum amount of data in gigabytes or megabytes to ingest per day for Application Insights.
caveats: First four gigabytes per month are free
Charges apply after free tier is exceeded

features.name: Telemetry Daily Cap Warnings
features.description: An alert system that warns users when telemetry data ingestion is approaching or exceeding the configured daily cap limit.
caveats: When warning triggers, data loss occurs
Data beyond the cap is not ingested
